title: Cabin CO2 headache cluster
trigger_patterns: two or more crew report headache or dizziness on the same day
the habitat CO2 reading shown on the console is trending up
engine level is watch or higher alongside headache reports

steps.text: Move to the module with the lowest cabin CO2 reading shown on the habitat display.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Note the CO2 value, the module name and the time.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Ask every crew member whether they have a headache, dizziness or nausea right now.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Stop exercise and strenuous tasks until the reading falls.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Tell the crew medical officer and log the reading in the health log.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: If the headache continues, open the onboard medical protocol for headache and follow it.
steps.source: onboard medical protocol - no drug doses are shown in LIGHTMINUTE

steps.text: Send a short summary to Earth: CO2 value, module, and how many crew are affected.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Escalate now if: confusion, vomiting, fainting, or the habitat CO2 alarm sounds.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure
